# Setup Specification
## Refinement Summary
- **Changed:** replace the intraday window and first-15-minute skip with daily-after-close evaluation and a minimum 30-day holding opportunity.
- **Changed:** remove intraday square-off, extend the time exit from 1,440 to 43,200 minutes and use CNC delivery instead of MIS to permit overnight holding.
- Stop-loss and target remain active from entry; the 30-day period is not a lock-in. All other deployed settings remain unchanged.

## Screener
- Name: Biggest Green Candle Finder (id `777a9e34`)
- Runtime parameters: universe=nifty_200
## Schedule & run window
- Days: Every trading day
- Interval: Daily (after close), until Pause / Stop
- **Changed:** Window: Open-ended; no intraday time gate, no first-15-minute skip, no intraday square-off and no setup end date.
## Universe & scope
- Universe: screener's own (NIFTY 200)
- Scope: All new matches
## Duplicate policy
- Policy: Alert once per stock per day
## Alerts
- Channels: In-app, Email
- Message template: {symbol} - {direction} - LTP: {ltp} - Volume: {volume} - Reason: Biggest green candle.
## Trade legs
- Direction: taken from the screener's direction column (BUY = long, SELL = short, NEUTRAL = no trade)
- Order entry: Market at the signal candle close
- Capital: Rs 100,000; default cap per position: Rs 100,000; max 3 open positions
- **Changed:** Product: CNC delivery (replaces intraday-only MIS for multi-day holding)
- Slippage: 0.05%; risk-based sizing: Off
- NIFTY filter: Off
- Stop-loss: 1% from entry (unchanged deployed fixed configuration)
- Exit legs: 1 target for 100% at 500% from entry (unchanged deployed fixed configuration)
- **Changed:** Time exit: 30 calendar days (43,200 minutes) after entry if stop-loss or target has not hit; earlier stop-loss/target exits remain enabled.
- Trailing: Off; adds: Off; exit on drop/opposite: Off
- Reference candle: signal; single leg: false; remainder: last_target; breakeven after first target: Off
## Guardrails
- Max alerts per day: 60
- Max daily loss: Off
- Max trades per day: 10
- Cooldown per stock: 30 min
- Max open positions per sector: Off
## Custom instructions (verbatim)
1.  Window
09:30–15:15 IST · skip first 15 min is not correct , window will be 30 days minium to allow stock to hit stoploss or target , the screener attached with this runs on daily timeframe

## Baseline (fixed for every setup)

- **Schedule:** runs at every Daily (after close) candle close (the screener's interval) from Start until Pause / Stop.
- **Data wait:** each run waits until every stock of the setup universe has the candle and its indicators in ClickHouse, at most 2 min 30 s; then entries, exits and stop-losses are handled with the data available.
- **Direction:** taken from the screener's `direction` column (BUY = long, SELL = short, NEUTRAL = no trade); the setup never decides BUY / SELL itself.
- **Capital per execution:** default Rs 100000; read from `setup.sizing.per_position_cap` at runtime. Backtest and Robo setup may override it without changing the strategy logic.
